__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see what appears to be a 3 sided pyramid with spidery arms and legs.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A tridrone is here doing a menial task.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: tridrone

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A cubic creature, with spiny arms and legs.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A quadrone is here watching for trespassers.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: quadrone

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A five-armed creature which resembles a starfish on thin stilt-like legs.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The pentadrone is here policing the area.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: pentadrone

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The decaton is a large, ten-tentacled sphere on stumpy legs.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A decaton is here overseeing the other modrons.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: decaton

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A cylidrical modron with 9 tentacles and stubby legs.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A nonaton is here preserving law and order.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: nonaton

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The octon has a collar at shoulder level with 8 tentacled arms growing out of
it.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An octon is here governing his ward of responsilbility.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: octon

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The septon appears as a human with a large bald head. It has a shoulder collar
with 7 tentacles coming from it.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A septon is here preserving order.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: septon

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
A hexton appears as a humanoid with 6 arms: 2 large human arms with 6 fingers,
and 4 tentacles below tipped with sharp claws.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A hexton is here watching over his armies.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: hexton

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Quintons look like tall, stocky humanoids with 4 flexible arms jutting from the
shoulders.  A prehensile tail serves as the creature's 5th arm, and they have
fan-like wings attached to their shoulders.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A quinton is here keeping records.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: quinton

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Tertians look very human, save for their 12 foot size, the horns jutting from
the sides of their bald heads, and the long prehensile tail ending in a mace-
like ball.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A tertian is here administering the law.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: tertian

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The secundi is an incredibly thin, tall humanoids with long, narrow faces
and deepset eyes. It radiates intense power.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A Secundus, one of the Viceroys of Nirvana, is here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: secundus

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Primus is a huge being who rises out of the energy pool and glares at you with
violet eyes. His right hand is wreathed in darkness, his left in light, and
he looks very displeased to see you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Primus, ruler of the Plane of Nirvana, forms out of an energy pool.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: primus
